text:
jordana: heads-up — CI anomaly when bringing up v2 quant runner on the sampled-split pipeline. noticed holdout accuracy jumps ~4% on one shard.
mina: can you paste the run id?
jordana: run: ci-eval/2026-03-19/qs-88, link: https://ci.redwood/ci-eval/qs-88
carol: quick glance: looks like cache warmup took a long time on the first batch, and we retried a tiny subset — could that have duplicated samples into the fold?
jordana: that's my hunch. logs show: 
```
INFO: kv_cache: warmup 0/1 done, keys=0
WARN: sampler: returned 3 ids, but requested 2
DEBUG: runner: batch expand with cached-prefix, original_len=2 -> expanded_len=3
```
mina: "sampler returned 3 ids" — that's weird. our stratified sampler shouldn't over-sample. which sampler version?
jordana: sampler v1.14.1 from wheel in /opt/runner, but the bundle also had a patched cache-policy plugin applied (policy=prefix-dedup:off).
oliver: @jordana can you dump the sample ids for that shard?
jordana: pasted below: `['s_1784', 's_1784', 's_814']` — duplicate s_1784. first seen in wave 0.
carol: ok dup -> holdout bleed. likely when cache-plugin expands an in-flight example to warm prefix, it mutated the batch vector that sampler trusts for uniqueness.
mina: interesting — locally I hit a related edgecase: when sampler yields a generator and someone iterates twice you can get duplicates unless materialized. but that wouldn't explain the extra id between processes.
devops-bot: deploy-notify: rollout pack/runner:v2-quant started by @carol at 2026-03-19T21:10Z
jordana: repro steps I'm testing now: run small evaluation with sampler from dataset-utils v0.9 and policy prefix-dedup:off. script: 
```
python -m eval.runner --dataset finance-holdout --sampler stratified --sampler-seed 42 --cache-policy prefix-dedup:off --shards 1
```
mina: try `--materialize-sampler` flag (available in latest test builds) — it converts generator -> list before handing to cache plugin. avoids double-iteration.
jordana: re-ran with materialize flag, duplicates gone, holdout accuracy back to baseline.
oliver: nice. but we need a proper fix not just a flag. open a runtime PR to make sampler contract explicit (iterator vs list) and add an assert in cache plugin to check uniqueness.
carol: agree. also add a CI test: synthetic-runner that simulates cache warmup expanding batches and assert no id duplication and holdout set untouched.
mina: I'll own the test + sampler contract doc, jordana can do the runtime assert + small patch.
jordana: assigning: mina -> eng-ml issue 412, jordana -> runtime PR 879. i'll post repro artifacts in the ticket.
carol: add a postmortem note in the eval-runbook: "cache plugins must not mutate batch id vectors; sampler must materialize uniqueness if consumed by multiple components"
oliver: and tag this for canary-run before full rollout of v2-quant. :eyes:
jordana: thanks all — follow-ups in 24h, will update issue and ping once PRs are up. :thumbsup:
